ble_219_0c087a34.name: norflash_build_protect_table
ble_219_0c087a34.summary: Build the table mapping SR block-protect bits to protected address ranges
ble_219_0c087a34.description: Generates, for a NOR flash of size param_2 bytes, an array of 12-byte entries {status_register_value, range_start, range_end} at 0x200035C0 and stores the entry count in 0x200038C0. Entry 0 is {0,0,0} (no protection) and entry 1 is {0x7C,0,size-1} (everything protected). It then loops over the power-of-two block sizes (4 KiB doubling, or 8 KiB when the flag in 0x200038C4[param_1] is set, up to 32 KiB) producing top/bottom-aligned ranges for the BP bits (value n*4), the TB bit 0x40 and the CMP bit 0x4000, as used by SPI NOR status register block protection. The table is later searched to pick the status-register value that protects a given region. Only param_1 == 0 is handled; any other value spins forever. param_1 also indexes the variant flag array at 0x200038C4.

params.name: param_1
params.description: flash instance (must be 0, otherwise infinite loop)

params.name: param_2

ble_219_0c087d34.name: norflash_cache_invalidate_range
ble_219_0c087d34.summary: Invalidate flash cache lines for an address range
ble_219_0c087d34.description: param_1 selects a flash window: 0 -> addresses in 0x2C000000..0x2FFFFFFF, 1 -> 0x34000000..0x37FFFFFF (any other value spins forever). If the address param_2 is outside the selected window the function returns param_1 and does nothing. For length param_3 > 0xFE0 it writes 1 to 0x07FFA038 (invalidate the whole cache) and returns 0. Otherwise it aligns param_2 down to 32 bytes and, for each 32-byte line up to param_2+param_3, writes the line address to 0x07FFA014 and 1 to 0x07FFA018 (single-line invalidate trigger). Returns 0 on success.

params.name: param_1
params.description: flash/cache window selector, 0 or 1

params.name: param_2
params.description: start address

params.name: param_3
params.description: length in bytes

returns.description: 0 when handled, param_1 (non-zero) when the address is outside the window
